verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents an automated Data Room that dynamically links the cap table to all supporting documents and is described as a 'secured data room' feature included even in the base pricing tier, matching the core diligence-room concept. However, evidence does not detail permissioning controls for external parties like counsel or investors (e.g., role-based/read-only access grants), so the 'permissioned... share with counsel and investors' half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit permission/role management for external viewers, evidence of investor/counsel-specific access workflows, independent corroboration of data room usability.
